title: Career Roadmap: Junior Data Engineer
summary: A Junior Data Engineer builds and maintains the systems that collect, transform, store, and deliver data for analytics, reporting, and machine learning. The role focuses on reliable data pipelines, databases, data quality, and cloud-based infrastructure.

blocks.text: For students pursuing a B.Sc. in Cloud Computing or Big Data Analytics, a strong pathway is to master SQL and Python, learn data modelling and ETL/ELT pipelines, and build projects that move data from raw sources into analytics-ready datasets.

blocks.text: A B.Sc. can be accepted for some junior data engineering roles. Others require a particular degree, relevant experience, or stronger computer science fundamentals. Always verify the requirements in the job description.

blocks.label: Learning priority
blocks.text: SQL first, then Python, followed by data pipelines and cloud services. Avoid trying to learn every cloud platform and big-data tool at once.

Build three or four complete projects that demonstrate data movement, reliability, and practical engineering.
Project 1 — ETL pipeline
Extract data from a public API, clean and transform it with Python, and load it into PostgreSQL.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: API ingestion, data cleaning, SQL, logging, and error handling.
Project 2 — Cloud data warehouse
Store raw CSV or JSON files in cloud object storage, transform them, and load analytics-ready tables into a warehouse.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: cloud storage, data modelling, warehouse queries, and access controls.
Project 3 — Automated daily pipeline
Schedule a daily ingestion and transformation workflow with retries, logging, and failure notifications.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: orchestration, scheduling, idempotency, and monitoring.
Project 4 — Large-scale data processing
Use PySpark to transform a sizeable public dataset and compare processing approaches.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: distributed processing, joins, partitioning, and performance analysis.

For every project, include a pipeline architecture diagram, sample input and output, setup instructions, data-quality checks, failure-handling logic, and screenshots or example query results. Explain why you chose each tool and how you would scale the system.

rows.text: Practise SQL from fundamentals through joins

blocks.text: Certifications can help structure learning, but hands-on projects and SQL proficiency are essential for entry-level roles. Consider a vendor certification only after completing practical exercises on the corresponding platform.
Search for these job titles:
Look for opportunities on company career pages, LinkedIn Jobs, Internshala, Wellfound, and university placement portals.

Prepare for interviews covering SQL queries, Python coding, database concepts, data modelling, ETL design, basic cloud architecture, and troubleshooting failed data pipelines. Practise explaining how your project handles duplicates, missing data, reruns, and changing source schemas.

Compensation varies by city, employer, degree requirements, technical skills, and the scale of the data platform. Junior data engineering salaries also differ between IT services companies, product firms, and cloud-focused teams.

For a meaningful estimate, compare recent vacancies for the same experience level and check whether the quoted compensation is fixed salary or total CTC. Do not assume that every role using a cloud or big-data tool pays at the same level.

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: Build a strong foundation in SQL and Python, create a reliable ETL pipeline, and then deploy a second project using one cloud platform. For a B.Sc. student, demonstrating how you build, test, automate, and troubleshoot a complete data pipeline is an effective way to prepare for junior data engineering roles.
